job: Offer words an agent wrote for a person, which stay the agent's until the person uses them.
purpose: A dashed block naming the agent and who it drafted for, the text in quotes, and Use and Discard. Use copies the text into the reason field and focuses it; the block folds to one line that stays as provenance, and the field records data-fd-drafted used, then edited once changed. Discard folds it away. The agent never commits.
useWhen: An agent drafted the reason or the answer for a decision a person signs.
A suggested reply or note must not be mistaken for the person's own words.

avoidWhen.when: The agent's text is its answer in a conversation.
The agent asks to run a tool.
Short completions offered while someone types.

states.name: waiting
states.how: no data-state: the text in quotes with Use and Discard

states.name: used
states.how: data-state="used", set by data-fd-draft="use"; fd-draft-used shows

states.name: edited
states.how: data-state="edited" once the person changes the words in the field

variants.useWhen: The field to fill is not the textarea of the enclosing fd-commit: give its id.

parts.role: The block, an aside labelled as a draft.
The agent, who it drafted for, and an icon.
The line shown once the draft is used.

keyboard.does: On Use: copies the draft into the field and moves focus there.
